title: The last card takes the root
hook: Removing the root leaves a hole the last key must repair.

knows: Compare numbers; read a short array, string, tree or graph as drawn.
Heap parent/child ordering and priority comparisons.
doesNotKnow: Restore heap order after replacing a removed minimum with the last leaf.

misconception: Removing a heap minimum can leave every other card where it was.
objective: Restore heap order after replacing a removed minimum with the last leaf.

claims.text: The last element fills the root hole, then descends through the smaller child. Choosing the larger child could leave the other child smaller than its parent, even when the chosen branch looks repaired.
